scene.compositeOrder: Draw back-to-front: background, then midground, then ground, then the player character, then foreground (occluder).

units.verticalOffsetPercent: percent of stage height, positive = down (range -100..100)
units.restoreGreenPercent: amount of original green re-blended after key-out (0 = fully despilled)
units.suggestedParallaxFactor: relative horizontal scroll speed vs camera; foreground ≈ 1.35 (fastest), ground = 1.0
